candidates.selection_pending: Rds(on) specified at -2.5 V. Existing Study A 1k/10k gate network does not establish -2.5 V at the minimum rail with assumed decoder VOL. Recalculate the network and verify loaded HC138 output/settling; not a blind CJ2305 substitution.

Rds(on) specified at +2.5 V. Conservative CH32V003 loaded VOH of 2.3 V does not establish that drive, especially with a gate series resistor and pull-down. Resolve drive margin or prefer a part rated at 1.8 V; threshold voltage alone is insufficient.
